title: reconcile: read and fold pending ADRs, flag a free later-tier story, and merge its own pull requests
summary: /reconcile reads ADRs not yet folded into the PRD (any status line but folded counts as pending), adds two findings (an ADR waiting to be folded; a later-tier story nothing blocks while an earlier tier is open), folds an ADR by replacing its status line in the same docs(prd) PR, and merges a bookmark-only PR on green. Version 29.
deferred: skills/reconcile/SKILL.md phase 0 and fold: the 'any other status line is pending' catch-all also takes ADRs marked Superseded, Rejected or Deprecated, and nothing handles a pending ADR that a later ADR replaces (wayfinder's ADRS dedupe writes that pair); a dead decision can be read as product truth and offered for folding. Needs one status rule shared by /reconcile, /prd-to-tickets and /wayfinder. Severity medium.
